in_arabic.name: فهم
in_arabic.meaning: فهم: تعني الفهم العميق و الإدراك الحاد للمعاني و المفاهيم
in_arabic.long_meaning: فهم: اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي و معناه الفهم العميق و الإدراك الحاد للمعاني و المفاهيم. ورد في القرآن الكريم في عدة مواضع، منها قوله تعالى: 'و ما يعلم تأويله إلا الله و الراسخون في العلم' ( آل عمران: 7 )، و هو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية و علمية، و يدل على عمق الفهم و الحكمة.

in_urdu.name: فہم
in_urdu.meaning: فہم: گہرا سمجھنا، تیز فہم ہونا، علم و حکمت
in_urdu.long_meaning: فہم: اردو میں اس نام کا مطلب ہے گہرا سمجھنا، تیز فہم ہونا، علم و حکمت۔ یہ نام عربی زبان کے 'فهم' سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے سمجھنا یا ادراک کرنا۔ اسلامی تقالید میں، فہم ایک قابل تعریف صفت ہے کیونکہ یہ فرد کی ذہنی اور روحانی نشوونما کی نشاندہی کرتی ہے۔

in_hindi.name: फह्म
in_hindi.meaning: फह्म: गहरा समझना, तेज समझ होना, ज्ञान और बुद्धिमत्ता
in_hindi.long_meaning: फह्म: हिंदी में इस नाम का अर्थ है गहरा समझना, तेज समझ होना, ज्ञान और बुद्धिमत्ता। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के 'فهم' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है समझना या बोध करना। इस्लामी परंपरा में, फह्म एक प्रशंसनीय विशेषता है क्योंकि यह व्यक्ति की मानसिक और आध्यात्मिक वृद्धि को दर्शाती है।

in_pashto.name: فهم
in_pashto.meaning: فهم: ژوره پوهه، تیز پوهه، علم او حکمت
in_pashto.long_meaning: فهم: په پښتو کې د دې نوم مطلب دى ژوره پوهه، تیز پوهه، علم او حکمت. دا نوم د عربي ژبې د 'فهم' څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې مطلب يې دى پوهه يا ادراک. په اسلامي دود کې، فهم يو ستايل شوی ځانګړتیا ده ځکه چې دا د فرد ذهني او روحاني ودې ته اشاره کوي.

in_english.name: Fahm
in_english.meaning: Fahm: profound understanding, sharp intellect, knowledge, and wisdom
in_english.long_meaning: Fahm: Derived from the Arabic root 'فهم', this name signifies profound understanding, sharp intellect, knowledge, and wisdom. It appears in several contexts in the Quran, emphasizing deep comprehension and insight. Fahm is a name that reflects spiritual and intellectual maturity, making it a cherished attribute in Islamic tradition.

data.cultural_impact: The name Fahm holds great significance in Islamic culture, as it signifies a person who is wise, knowledgeable, and insightful. In Arabic society, creating meaningful and profound names for children is an essential aspect of their upbringing, with Fahm being a name that conveys the value of education, wisdom, and self-awareness. As education is a fundamental component of Islamic society, names like Fahm serve to instill these values into children from a young age. Furthermore, the name Fahm can be seen as a source of inspiration for individuals striving for knowledge and wisdom, reminding them of the importance of understanding the world around them and the significance of acquiring knowledge to enhance their personal growth and contribute positively to their communities.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Fahm carries a profound meaning as it reflects the various stages of a person's journey towards understanding and realizing the divine truths of God. The ability to gain knowledge, wisdom, and insights is seen as a gift from God, allowing individuals to connect more deeply with their creator and ultimately hone their spiritual development. In Islamic theology, the pursuit of knowledge is considered a crucial aspect of the faith, with Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him) stating, "The seeking of knowledge is an obligation for every Muslim." In this sense, the name Fahm can serve as a call to action, encouraging individuals to seek knowledge and understanding not only of the world around them but also of the spiritual truths and wisdom contained within the teachings of Islam. Through the regular practice of seeking knowledge and wisdom, individuals can deepen their spiritual connection with God, fostering a greater sense of peace, harmony, and contentment in their lives.
